description: This file defines the IBatchContainerBatch interface, which represents a batch of queue messages composed of multiple IBatchContainer instances within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: IBatchContainerBatch
classes.description: An interface representing a batch of queue message containers, inheriting from IBatchContainer and providing access to a list of BatchContainers.

methods.name: BatchContainers
methods.description: A property that gets the list of IBatchContainer instances that comprise this batch.
